purpose: Portable reproduction of the additional numerical and scripted HTTP audits reported for release 0.1.3.
prerequisite: Install the repository package with python -m pip install -e .; the HTTP audit also requires a permitted loopback socket.
portability_check: Both scripts completed from outside the repository working directory using the isolated installed 0.1.3 package.

randomized.scope: Separate Decimal arithmetic for synthetic scalar/vector ledgers and rolling-origin metrics; no stochastic calibration or real-project validation.

http_harness.scope: Real local HTTP transport plus adapter, harness, numerical engine and file publication; scripted stub responses, no live LLM.

limitations: Synthetic checks only; no real-project forecast validation.
Stochastic shocks are disabled in the vectorised ledger check; interval calibration is not assessed.
The HTTP server returns scripted tool calls and uses an explicit dummy key; no live model or external service is contacted.
